0x187fa3b: [S45][?87] Long ago, when Sinnoh was born, Pokemon and humans gave each other gifts and supported one another.\pAnd so, some Pokemon, wishing to be able to help humans and appear before them at any time, learned to commune with other Pokemon.\pSince then, whenever a human steps into the tall grass, a Pokemon comes leaping out.
0x187faef: [F9FA][?87] In the beginning, all that existed was a swirling vortex of chaos.\pWhile all was in chaos, a single Egg appeared at the center of the world.\pFrom that scattered Egg, the First One was born.
0x187fbc3: [?87] When two beings offered their prayers, the one known as the Being of Matter was born.\pWhen three lives offered their prayers, the one known as the Being of Spirit was born.\pAnd as the world came into being, the First One sank into slumber.
0x187fc33: [FC87] After a Pokemon caught from the sea or the rivers has been eaten,\pwash its bones clean and gently return them to the water.\pDo this, and the Pokemon can grow its flesh anew and come back to this world.
0x187fcbb: [FC87] The Pokemon live within the forest. There they shed their hides, become human again, and fall asleep.\pThen they don their Pokemon hides once more and come into the village.
0x187fd26: [S30][BUF87] Humans wed Pokemon, and Pokemon wed humans.\pIn the old days, humans and Pokemon were one and the same, so such things were simply ordinary.
